notes.title: Release Note
notes.content:
Dear players, v1.0.0 beta released. 

We know there are some Bugs. We will Fix it soon. 
Please send us bug reports in 'bugs' discussion. 

Don't forget, game is in early access now.

Thanks for your patience.
